body: Founder live report: '/' key did nothing to open chat, so slash-commands like /help were unreachable without first pressing Enter/C/Y/T. Added SDLK_SLASH as an open-chat binding in both the Town and in-match event loops, seeding the buffer with '/' itself (same non-leaking keydown-before-StartTextInput shape Enter/C/Y/T already use). The underlying dispatch (chat_send_or_command routing '/'-prefixed lines to the real MUD via town_send_command) already existed and worked -- the gap was purely that '/' itself never opened chat. Live-verified end-to-end via a temporary Xvfb + synthetic-SDL-event test hook (reverted before commit): real disposable login, injected / -> help -> Enter, confirmed cmdHelp's real output landed in the shared combat log. go test ./... clean. Commit 5fae09d.
title: Town/in-match chat: "/" opens chat pre-seeded with "/" for quick MUD slash-commands
